headline: Polymarket Suffers Security Breach With Users Reporting Stolen Funds
summary: Users of prediction market platform Polymarket reported account compromises and losses totaling up to $800,000 following a hacker attack.
why: Polymarket is a prominent decentralized prediction market platform operating on blockchain infrastructure. Security incidents undermine user trust and highlight vulnerabilities in crypto-based platforms.

impacts.name: Prediction Markets and Crypto Protocols
impacts.why: Security breaches and compromised user funds erode confidence in decentralized applications and invite increased regulatory scrutiny.
